site.title: Lico's Awesome Archive
site.tagline: my little corner of the interest. games, experiments, and other stuff i made to learn things.
about: hi, i'm Lico! welcome to my web.
this is where i keep the games and experiments i make for fun. each one started with a question i wanted to figure out. once i figured it out, it's done.
some are finished, some are prototypes, some are parked because they already taught me what i wanted. all of them are a little dumb.
play stuff right here in the browser or grab a download. oh, and Dave lives at the bottom. he's tired. be nice.

games.title: Spelighter
games.description: Clancies explores a dark cave system with a flashlight. Climb, swim, find the way out.

games.title: HOWL : Lost Pancake
games.description: Clancies the axolotl goes into a cave to find a lost pancake. Short, pretty difficult platformer.
